# mcp-spec-compliance-mcp

> MCP Spec Compliance MCP — audits any MCP server.json against the official Model Context Protocol spec (2025-12-11). HMAC-signed conformity reports. By MEOK AI Labs.

MCP server by MEOK AI Labs. Framework: fastmcp. Transport: stdio.

## Tools
- audit_server_json
- check_required_fields
- check_naming_conventions
- list_spec_versions
- generate_passing_template
- sign_conformity_report

## Install
```
pip install mcp-spec-compliance-mcp
```

## Links
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/mcp-spec-compliance-mcp/
- Docs: https://meok.ai
